bullets.text: A Kenyan doomsday cult leader, Paul Mackenzie, has been sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of 191 people, including children, whom he ordered to starve to death.
A new wave of bomb threats has targeted European airlines, following similar threats against media outlets, though no link has been established between the two.
Pope Leo has commenced a lengthy trip to Latin America, visiting Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru, weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery.
Australia's booming tallow industry is exploring turning animal by-products into renewable fuels, potentially reducing the nation's reliance on imported fuel.
An endangered crayfish species is being returned to its habitat months after bushfires caused widespread destruction in Victoria.
David Jones reportedly fell months behind on payments to some small Australian brands before entering administration, as smaller local businesses are at the bottom of the creditor pile.
The US economy surpassed expectations by adding 165,000 jobs in October, strengthening forecasts for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike.
US stocks, particularly chipmakers and tech companies, rebounded after a recent rout, despite economic data reinforcing expectations of a December rate hike.
Washington has warned China to immediately fulfill its commitments under the Busan trade deal, specifically regarding the supply of rare earths and other critical products.
